**Cogent**: Cogent has 40-50 employees, founded in 2024. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India. Has $53M in total funding, with 2 prior funding rounds.

[Cogent](https://linkedin.com/company/cogentsecurity)'s Head of Growth, [Alexander Semien](https://linkedin.com/in/alexander-semien), breaks down the diverging narrative of AI-in-cybersecurity across two of the frontier labs.

Yesterday's announcement from [OpenAI](https://linkedin.com/company/openai) positioned Daybreak as a defensive partnership story with legacy cybersecurity companies. [Anthropic](https://linkedin.com/company/anthropicresearch)'s Mythos, however, landed as offensive proof of maturing models - with early access given exclusively to mega-enterprises.

Both rest on the same underlying capabilities, and both stop short of the actual hard part: turning findings into fixes, on the time scale modern adversaries operate on.

# Uptiq Expands Banking Leadership to Scale AI Deployment at Financial Institutions

 August 18, 2026 

 

Uptiq has expanded its U.S. banking leadership team with three senior appointments as the financial technology company works to move more AI deployments at banks and credit unions from pilot programs into production environments.

The company named Gagan Kanjlia Chief Banking Officer, Amit Parmar Executive Vice President of Strategic Accounts and Data Strategy, and Marc Billanti Senior Vice President of Sales. Together, the executives will oversee product strategy, data and regulatory frameworks, strategic banking relationships and commercial execution for Uptiq’s Bank and Credit Union market.

The appointments come as financial institutions evaluate how to operationalize AI within lending, deposits, wealth management, compliance and other workflows. Unlike standalone AI applications, deployments in regulated banking environments must account for existing core systems as well as requirements around security, explainability, audit readiness and human oversight.
